title: Animation
content:
Dear Melody,  
I have a problem with the animation: I selected a stage from the CLO Library and used the motion “Walking in place.” I paid attention to the following points:

> \- Simulation mode is set to Animation (Stable).
> 
> \- All layers are set to 0.
> 
> \- PD ist set to 7-10.
> 
> \- Additional Thickness Collision may remain around 2-2.5.

> \- Delete all pattern pieces that will not be visible during the final animation (e.g. pocket bags.)
> 
> \- No pattern pieces on Freeze/Deactivate/Strengthen.

But the pants still tear apart in the lower area. The sleeves of the shirt also stretch out. What could be causing this?

Attached a video. 

Merci beacoup & Best, Tina

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AAscdZ6Vsk4?start=0

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: It is correct to open the project file directly, but the problem you can see in the video seems to be that the pants are moving, and the two pants patterns on both legs cannot distinguish between inside and outside, resulting in a mix of positions.The sleeve of the shirt also collides with the body's pattern, and the same phenomenon occurs.First of all, I recommend separating the layers.Pants leg one pattern: 0The rest of the pants pattern: 1Red Body: 2Sky Blue Sleeve: 3Red Sleeve: 4It is safe to lower the collision thickness to 1.0 in an environment where the location of the fabric can overlap due to the large pattern area.If you have time to spare, you can choose Hi-Res Garment to greatly increase the stability of the simulation during the animation render.The particle spacing can be reversed even after Hi-Res Garment activation, so consider it.
Reply 1: @fadyboo - Thank you so much! @Tina - The oversize of the garments in the animation can require the workarounds that fadyboo has described. The animation rendering process will take longer then, but if it is the only way, then it is the way. Please get back to this thread in case the issues aren't solved after following the tips above.
Reply 2: Many thanks 🙏🏻
content_description: A troubleshooting guide to resolving garment tearing and stretching issues during animation in CLO software.

title: Input fields not working
content:
For > 6 months now, I've been having an issue where some of the input fields to not actually save the value I entered. This happens particularly often in the "Print Layout" configuration fields. Sometimes it fixes itself eventually – although I'm not sure what exactly helps.   
  
Below is a screen recording of my problem. I'm trying to set the width of the "Duoplex" fabric to 35cm, but the change is not being saved/applied. I'm pressing enter, clicking into/out of the field to no effect. Switching to a different fabric and back reveals that the change did not save.

I'm using the latest version of Clo3d (2025.2.368 r54927).

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vw0g8nUexS4
content_description: This page documents a persistent issue with input fields not saving values in Clo3d's Print Layout settings, illustrated by a screen recording and user observations.

title: Notice: a recent issue with CLO/MD LiveSync 2.2.2
content:
Hi everyone!

This was a mistake on our end. CLO/MD LiveSync version 2.2.2 was published on Fab prematurely; it is a newer version meant for CLO / Marvelous Designer 2026.0, which has not been released yet.   
  
If you are encountering an issue where a garment fails to send to Unreal Engine and the progress bar is stuck at 50%, please roll back to version 2.2.1 by following these steps.  
  
1\. .Go to our LiveSync version archive and download version 2.2.1 for UE 5.7. <https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45304267645593-LiveSync-2-version-archive>

  
2\. Next, navigate to the UE 5.7 installation directory (e.g., C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace).  
  
3\. Then, Delete version 2.2.2, then unzip the downloaded 2.2.1 package and place the entire 'CLOLiveSync' folder into that directory.  
  
Once CLO / Marvelous Designer 2026.0 is released, please make sure to remove version 2.2.1 and download version 2.2.2 directly from the Epic Games Launcher. 🙂

If you are experiencing any other issues with LiveSync or your CLO / Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine workflows, we're here to help!

Cheers,

Bryan
content_description: This page provides instructions for rolling back to LiveSync version 2.2.1 to resolve compatibility issues with Unreal Engine 5.7 caused by the premature release of version 2.2.2.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Yes, this is possible. For the rest you may need help out side, but a quick google search of "how to add a 3d viewer to a website" has a lot of resources 🙂
